summary: This document defines how versions of the NFS protocol bind to RPC-over-RDMA version 1, which enables direct data placement so data can move straight between memory without extra copying. It obsoletes RFC 5667.

eli5.summary: It lets a file server drop data straight into the right spot in a computer's memory, like a delivery driver putting a package right in your room.

questions: nfs upper layer binding for rpc-over-rdma
